narrative.intro: Massachusetts Institute of Technology obligated $1B in federal contract dollars in FY2026 to date. Massachusetts Institute of Technology won 26 awards this period, with an average award size of $39.8M. Massachusetts Institute of Technology obligations fell 28.3% year over year. Massachusetts Institute of Technology obligations by fiscal year were $1.1B in FY21, $1.1B in FY22, $1.4B in FY23, $1.5B in FY24, $1.4B in FY25, and $1B in FY26. Massachusetts Institute of Technology received $919M in Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Biotechnology). Massachusetts Institute of Technology received $116M in Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology). The current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity. The listed figures reflect contract obligations except where an item is explicitly described as a total contract value.
